people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.
translations.bsb: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: Ephraim practices prostitution there, and Israel is defiled.
translations.kjv: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
translations.asv: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing: there whoredom is found in Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
